pages.title: Projekte (trash: "Projekte · Papierkorb")
pages.purpose: All projects as board (by project status), list or timeline; quick-create, drag between status columns, move dates; trash view with restore.
pages.permission: projects.view (layout also requires the projects module)

urlState.meaning: board (default) | list | timeline | trash (trash view, projects.manage)

fields.name: view
fields.label: Ansicht
fields.notes: ml-auto; labels sr-only on phones (icons only)

sections.title: Board
sections.notes: Kanban (kibo-ui) per project status column with count; cards: colour dot, name, description snippet, end date (red if overdue), task progress done/all, lead initials; card → /projects/<id>. Drag & drop saves at once (moveProjectAction, toast on error). Quick-add input 'Neues Projekt…' + '+' at the bottom of every column (createProjectAction). Max 500 projects.

sections.title: Zeitachse
sections.notes: bars start–end grouped by status; drag moves dates (moveProjectDates, projects.manage); empty 'Keine Projekte gefunden.'

sections.title: Papierkorb
sections.notes: hint 'Gelöschte Projekte bleiben 30 Tage hier und lassen sich wiederherstellen.'; empty 'Der Papierkorb ist leer.'

pages.empty: EmptyState 'Noch keine Projekte' / 'Ein Projekt bündelt Aufgaben, Termine, Dateien und Verknüpfungen, z. B. „Sommerfest 2027“.' + button 'Neues Projekt' (projects.manage)
pages.phone: Board scrolls horizontally (17rem columns); segment labels icon-only; primary as round +.
uxNotes: Trash is a value of ?view (view=trash), while HR uses ?status=trash and contacts ?trash=1.
Board quick-add and the /projects/new page are two create paths with different results (quick add = name only, lands on the project page).
'Alle Aufgaben' is both a header button and a sidebar entry (duplicate path).
Progress counts are computed from up to 10,000 task rows loaded on every visit; project list capped at 500 without paging.

pages.title: Neues Projekt
pages.purpose: Create a project with name, description, status, lead, dates, colour and custom fields.
uxNotes: Status (often ≤ 5 columns) uses a NativeSelect, not <Choice>.

pages.title: <Project name> (editable inline in the title)
pages.purpose: One project: activity feed with comments, progress, description and details, documents, linked records; its tasks as board/list/timeline/calendar; time tracked on it.
pages.permission: projects.view (edit: projects.manage; Zeit view: shifts module + shifts.self/view/manage/approve)

header.badge: project status (secondary when it counts as done)

urlState.meaning: overview (default) | board | list | timeline | calendar | time
calendar sub-view in the calendar task view (month/week/agenda)
new | <entry id> = time entry sheet (Zeit view)

sections.title: Ansicht
sections.notes: Segments Übersicht · Board · Liste · Zeitachse · Kalender · Zeit; on overview right-aligned above the content, in task views inside the task toolbar.

sections.title: Aktivität
sections.notes: CommentForm (text, 'Diktieren', 'Datei anhängen', 'Foto aufnehmen'; attachments land in the project's documents) + feed of comments and changes of the project and its tasks; task entries link to ?view=list&task=<id>; author can 'Bearbeiten' / 'Kommentar löschen' (confirm 'Kommentar löschen?').

sections.title: Fortschritt (aside)
sections.notes: progress bar, '{done} von {count} Aufgaben erledigt', '{count} Aufgaben überfällig' (red), link 'Zum Board' → ?view=board

sections.title: Beschreibung (aside)
sections.notes: same form as Details, one SaveBar

sections.title: Details (aside)
sections.notes: Status, Verantwortlich, Start, Ende, Farbe, custom fields (stacked); fieldset disabled without projects.manage

sections.title: Verknüpft (aside)
sections.notes: description 'Wiki-Seiten, Veranstaltungen, Kontakte … die zum Projekt gehören.'; list of linked records (title link + kind label) with X 'Verknüpfung entfernen'; LinkPicker 'Suchen und verknüpfen …' (global search, ≥2 chars, groups wiki/events/contacts/invoices/forms/rentals; click = link at once)

sections.title: Aufgaben (board/list/timeline/calendar)
sections.notes: TasksView limited to this project (see /projects/tasks); quick-add puts new tasks into this project; no Projekt filter/column

sections.title: Zeit
sections.notes: Clock box: 'Auf Projekt einstempeln' / 'Ausstempeln' (shifts.self + in team), hint 'Einstempeln startet die Zeit auf diesem Projekt.' or 'Läuft gerade auf {project} seit {time} – Ausstempeln beendet das.', ghost '+ Zeit nachtragen' → ?time=new. TimeEntryList with Person column (newest 500). Aside 'Zeit auf dem Projekt': total + per person.

links: linked records (wiki, events, contacts, invoices, forms, rental objects)
pages.phone: RecordLayout: aside (progress, details, files, links) below the activity feed; segment labels icon-only.
uxNotes: Three save models on one page: name saves inline on blur, description/details via SaveBar, links/comments/checklists at once.
Page title is an <input> (InlineTitle) inside PageHeader; docs say the title shows only in the top bar for record pages.
On overview the view Segments sit alone above the content, in task views inside the toolbar: switch moves position between views.
Project description is rich text (RichTextEditor) while task description is a plain Textarea rendered as Markdown.
Removing a link (X) has no confirm; link picker results disappear only after the add succeeds (no 'linked' toast).
Time sheet param is ?time=new|<id>, while /shifts/me and /shifts/hours use ?new=time / ?edit=<id> for the same form.
Time entry delete without confirm (shared TimeEntryForm).

pages.title: Alle Aufgaben
pages.purpose: All tasks of the org across projects (and without one) as board, list, timeline or calendar; filter, bulk-move, bulk-trash, open the task panel.

urlState.meaning: calendar sub-view (month/week/agenda) in the calendar view

fields.name: due
fields.label: Fällig
fields.notes: Jede Fälligkeit / Überfällig / Nächste 7 Tage / Ohne Datum

sections.title: Board
sections.notes: task columns (task_statuses scope task); cards: title, tags (max 2 + '+n'), project name, snippet, due (red if overdue), checklist progress, assignee initials; drag saves at once; quick-add 'Neue Aufgabe…' per column → opens the new task panel. Max 1000 tasks.

sections.title: Zeitachse
sections.notes: grouped by project ('Ohne Projekt'); drag moves start/due (moveTaskDates)

sections.title: Kalender
sections.notes: tasks with due date as all-day entries ('✓' when done), month/week/agenda; drag changes due (moveTaskDue)

overlays.title: <Task title>

actions.label: (autosave)
actions.target: autosaveTaskAction (AutosaveForm, 700 ms debounce; status 'Speichert…' / 'Gespeichert.' in the sheet meta slot)

actions.label: Kommentieren
actions.notes: attachments only when the task has a project

overlays.notes: meta 'Angelegt am {date} · erledigt am {date}'; Aktivität section (comments + changes) under the fields.

pages.phone: Board horizontal scroll; list as cards without tick boxes (no bulk on phones); segment labels icon-only.
uxNotes: Task panel autosaves (no SaveBar), while the project page uses SaveBar: two save models in one area.
Checklist remove button is opacity-0 until hover/focus (docs: nothing only on hover).
No create page or primary button for tasks; only per-column quick add on the board (list/timeline/calendar views have no way to create a task).
No trash view for tasks (trashed tasks can't be restored from the UI).
Project select in the task panel is a NativeSelect of all projects.
Five FilterMenus + view Segments in one toolbar.

pages.title: Einstellungen
pages.purpose: Define the columns of the task board and of the project board (name, colour, 'zählt als erledigt', order).

sections.title: Spalten des Boards
sections.notes: description projects.setupHint; one inline row per column + empty row to add

sections.title: Spalten der Projekte
sections.notes: same rows for project statuses; description projects.projectSetupHint

actions.label: Spalte löschen
actions.result: toast 'Spalte gelöscht.' or error 'Die Spalte enthält noch Aufgaben.'; disabled when only one column

uxNotes: Column delete (red trash icon) without confirm.
Reordering via up/down buttons with a full page round trip each, while boards themselves support drag & drop.
Row hidden-label inputs (aria-label only) – no visible column headers.
